text:
Jesper Boqvist came back to New Jersey and started scoring. The Devils drafted him in 2017, watched him win a Stanley Cup in Florida, and now have him back on about 11 and a half minutes a night. He has 6 goals and 10 points in 19 games, which is already close to his full total from 73 games with the Panthers last season (13 points). His best night came in the 7-4 win in Washington on Nov. 14: a goal that tied the game 3-3 and two assists.

Enjoy it, but don't bank on the rate. Those 6 goals came on 3.3 expected goals, a 24% shooting percentage against 6% last season, and our numbers flag him as due to cool. New Jersey gets about 56% of the expected goals with him on the ice at five on five, so he isn't just along for the ride.

Last season Evolving-Hockey had him below replacement, with his team creating little offense when he was out there. On a Devils team that has won eight of ten, he's playing a better version of his game. How much sticks when the shots stop falling is the thing to watch.
